themes.name: Affordable Housing and Rentals
themes.rule: Proposals for creating, converting, subsidizing, improving, or regulating housing and rental conditions for residents belong here.

themes.name: School Learning and Support
themes.rule: Proposals concerning school facilities, teachers, class sizes, student learning, meals, or extracurricular educational support belong here.

themes.name: Transit Service and Fares
themes.rule: Proposals that improve public transport routes, schedules, rider information, or transit affordability belong here.

themes.name: Neighborhood Green Recreation
themes.rule: Proposals for parks, gardens, trees, playgrounds, dog areas, and other outdoor neighborhood recreation spaces belong here.

themes.name: Public Health and Care
themes.rule: Proposals that expand medical care, mental-health services, preventive screening, specialist access, or in-home care belong here.

themes.name: Community and Street Safety
themes.rule: Proposals addressing emergency response, crime prevention, street lighting, patrols, surveillance, or safer road crossings belong here.

themes.name: Sustainable Resource Management
themes.rule: Proposals to reduce emissions, pollution, single-use materials, or waste through energy, recycling, composting, or environmental monitoring belong here.

themes.name: Arts, Culture, and Libraries
themes.rule: Proposals for public art, festivals, museum access, libraries, or cultural programming belong here.

themes.name: Local Jobs and Business
themes.rule: Proposals that support local hiring, small businesses, workspaces, licensing, or worker reskilling belong here.

themes.name: Municipal Service Access
themes.rule: Proposals that make it easier for residents to request, complete, or receive city administrative services belong here.

themes.name: Digital Access and Transparency
themes.rule: Proposals providing public internet access or publishing city data, spending, and other government information belong here.
